wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap roof and entry pavilion outlines, the exact February 2013 Qualla photograph, project documents giving ten petals, an 80-metre span and 60-metre nominal maximum, and original independent elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain all ten asymmetric petals, glazing, open oculus and splayed supports. Near levels refine shell curvature, frames and the diagrid.
limitations: The model represents the Marina Bay waterfront museum exterior as photographed in February 2013, including its petals, open central oculus, support basket and entry pavilion. Interior galleries and neighboring Marina Bay Sands buildings are outside scope.

The mapped outline fixes the petal rim positions and compass directions. The heights of individual petals, shell profiles, underside junctions and glass details are estimated from the bay view and published overall dimensions.
The original regional elevation field provides the surrounding waterfront grade. The reflecting pool and access thresholds are represented approximately.
